edits.current: Director fees (honorarios de junta directiva) are not paid under an employment contract, and cesantias is a prestacion social of the employment contract (CST art. 249; Law 50 of 1990 art. 99), so no fund affiliation and no return record exist for a fee-only director. Where the same person also holds an employment contract, that contract is reported as an ordinary employee (see the executive director row). The withholding on the fees is a Form 350 matter outside this filing.

edits.current: The published layouts carry no header, no trailer, no record count and no control total (Simple S.A. 'Manual Cesantias' s. 3.2; see File Structure). The control is the total payable returned by the operator (E11), which is reconciled against the engine's own sum of T14 before payment, because a truncated upload is not self-detecting.

edits.current: There is no nil return. The deposit is a payment per employee (Law 50 of 1990 art. 99 num. 3), not a declaration: the return consists of one record per employee in service at 31 December whose liquidation is at or above one day of one SMMLV (Population Rules Step 0; File Structure, minimum collection), and the layout has no header or empty-return construct. Where no employee meets the population rule for the accrual year, no return is built and nothing is deposited.
